 found varchar2(1):= 'N';

 i_rows number ;

 for counter in 1..i_rows loop
 if get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_DATE',counter) = :staff_off_day.unavail_date

 then

 exit;

 end if ;
 end;
END;
 IF found = 'N' THEN
 return FAlSE;
 ELSE
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
END;

 i_rows number ;
 V_RG varchar2(1):='N';
BEGIN
 begin
 :control_block.query_done := 'N' ;
 IF :system.record_status != 'QUERY' THEN
 if :s_from_time is null and :s_to_time is null then
 :from_time := null ;
 :to_time := null ;

 check_package_failure ;

 :from_time := to_date(to_char(:staff_off_day.unavail_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||:s_from_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI') ;
 :to_time := to_date(to_char(:staff_off_day.unavail_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||:s_to_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI') ;
 if :to_time < :from_time then
 show_error('12119') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if;
 end if ;
END IF;
 end;

/************* OLD VALUE CHANGED REMOVING FROM RECORD GROUP*****************************/
 if ( :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date is not null 
 and :staff_off_day.old_staff is not null 
 and ( :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date != :staff_off_day.unavail_date
 or :staff_off_day.old_staff != :staff_off_day.staff_no

 or :staff_off_day.old_to_time != :staff_off_day.to_time
 )

then

 if i_rows > 0 then

 if get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_DATE',counter) = :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date 
 and get_group_char_cell('DATE_LIST.STAFF_NO',counter) = :staff_off_day.old_staff
 and get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_FROM',counter) = :staff_off_day.old_from_time 
 and get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_TO',counter) = :staff_off_day.old_to_time
 then
 delete_group_row('DATE_LIST',counter) ;
 exit;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 end if ;
end if;
 /*********** END OF OLD VALUE CHANGED REMOVING FROM RECORD GROUP*****************************/

/*message('0'||:staff_off_day.old_staff);pause;
message('00'||:staff_off_day.old_unavail_date);pause;
message('000'||:staff_off_day.old_from_time);pause;
message('0000'||:staff_off_day.old_to_time );pause;*/

/************* DUPLICATE CHECK STARTS*****************************/

 )
 then

*/

 V_RG:='N';
 -- if :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date is null OR
 if (:staff_off_day.old_unavail_date is not null 
 and ( :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date != :staff_off_day.unavail_date or
 :staff_off_day.old_from_time != :staff_off_day.from_time or

 )
 )
 then
 V_RG:='Y'; 
 end if;
 if :staff_off_day.old_staff is null or
 (:staff_off_day.old_staff is not null 
 and (:staff_off_day.old_staff != :staff_off_day.staff_no)
 )
 then
 V_RG:='Y';
 end if;

 IF V_RG='Y' THEN 
 i_rows := get_group_row_count('DATE_LIST') ;
 
 if i_rows > 0 then
 for counter in 1..i_rows loop
 
 --if get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_DATE',counter) = :staff_off_day.unavail_date
 if get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_DATE',counter) = lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:staff_off_day.from_time) 
 and get_group_char_cell('DATE_LIST.STAFF_NO',counter) = :staff_off_day.staff_no
 and ( get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_FROM',counter) between lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:staff_off_day.from_time) 
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:staff_off_day.to_time) -(1/(60*60*24))
 or get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_TO',counter)-(1/(60*60*24)) between lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:staff_off_day.from_time)

 or :staff_off_day.from_time between get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_FROM',counter) 
 AND get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_TO',counter)-(1/(60*60*24))
 or :staff_off_day.to_time-(1/(60*60*24)) between get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_FROM',counter) 
 AND get_group_date_cell('DATE_LIST.UNAVL_TO',counter)
 )
 then

 show_error('12134') ; 
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 end if;
 end loop ;
 end if ;
 END IF;

/*************START ADDING RECORD TO RECORD GROUP*****************************/

 if :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date is null or
 (:staff_off_day.old_unavail_date is not null 
 and ( :staff_off_day.old_unavail_date != :staff_off_day.unavail_date
 or :staff_off_day.old_from_time != :staff_off_day.from_time

 Set_Group_Date_Cell( 'DATE_LIST.UNAVL_TO',get_group_row_count('DATE_LIST'),:staff_off_day.to_time); 
 end if ;
 
END;

select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'UNAVL' 
and ( UPPER(description) like '%'||:control_block.reason||'%' 
 or code like '%'||:control_block.reason||'%'
 )
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: STAFF_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select staff_no,Initcap(first_name)||' '||Initcap(last_name) ,to_char(schedule_from_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') SFD, team_id, emp_class from employees 
where emp_class in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1))
 and emp_class not in('FSTAF')
and (staff_no = nvl(:staff_off_day.staff_no, staff_no)
 or first_name like '%'||:staff_off_day.staff_no||'%'
 or last_name like '%'||:staff_off_day.staff_no||'%')
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) 
order by first_name
